queries.sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(p.price * o.qty) AS revenue FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id JOIN orders o ON p.id = o.product_id GROUP BY c.name;
SELECT p.name, SUM(o.qty) AS total_qty FROM products p JOIN orders o ON p.id = o.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_qty DESC, p.name ASC LIMIT 3;
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.created_at) AS month, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM orders o GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
SELECT title FROM books WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT book_id FROM loans WHERE returned = 1)
SELECT a.name, COUNT(l.id) AS loan_count FROM authors a LEFT JOIN books b ON a.id = b.author_id LEFT JOIN loans l ON b.id = l.book_id WHERE l.returned = 1 GROUP BY a.name
SELECT ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(l.returned_at) - JULIANDAY(l.loaned_at)), 2) AS average_duration FROM loans l WHERE l.returned = 1
SELECT d.name, ROUND(AVG(e.salary), 2) AS avg_salary FROM departments d JOIN employees e ON d.id = e.dept_id GROUP BY d.name;
SELECT e.name FROM employees e WHERE e.hired_at LIKE '2023%'
SELECT d.name, MAX(e.salary) AS max_salary FROM departments d JOIN employees e ON d.id = e.dept_id GROUP BY d.name
SELECT d.name, SUM(v.cost) AS total_cost FROM doctors d LEFT JOIN visits v ON d.id = v.doctor_id GROUP BY d.id;
SELECT p.name FROM patients p JOIN visits v ON p.id = v.patient_id GROUP BY p.id HAVING COUNT(v.id) > 1;
SELECT p.name, MAX(v.cost) AS cost FROM patients p JOIN visits v ON p.id = v.patient_id GROUP BY p.id;
SELECT w.city, SUM(s.weight_kg) AS total_weight FROM warehouses w JOIN shipments s ON w.id = s.warehouse_id GROUP BY w.city;
SELECT w.city, MAX(s.weight_kg) AS weight_kg FROM warehouses w JOIN shipments s ON w.id = s.warehouse_id GROUP BY w.city;
SELECT shipped_at AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM shipments GROUP BY shipped_at;
SELECT subject, ROUND(AVG(score), 2) AS average_score FROM grades GROUP BY subject;
SELECT name FROM students WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM grades WHERE score < 80);
SELECT name, SUM(score) AS total_score FROM students JOIN grades ON students.id = grades.student_id GROUP BY name ORDER BY total_score DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT owner, balance_start + SUM(signed) AS balance FROM accounts JOIN transactions ON accounts.id = transactions.account_id GROUP BY owner;
SELECT owner FROM accounts WHERE balance_start + SUM(signed) < 0;
SELECT created_at AS date, SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'debit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_debit FROM transactions GROUP BY created_at;
SELECT title FROM events WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT event_id FROM registrations);
SELECT title, COUNT(*) AS registration_count FROM events JOIN registrations ON events.id = registrations.event_id GROUP BY title ORDER BY registration_count DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT user_name FROM registrations GROUP BY user_name HAVING COUNT(event_id) >= 2;
SELECT c.name, COUNT(t.id) AS open_ticket_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN tickets t ON c.id = t.customer_id AND t.status = 'open' GROUP BY c.name;
SELECT ROUND(AVG(t.closed_at - t.created_at) * 24, 2) AS average_resolution_time FROM tickets t WHERE t.status = 'closed';
SELECT c.name FROM customers c WHERE c.id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM tickets);
SELECT p.name, SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty FROM products p LEFT JOIN stock s ON p.id = s.product_id GROUP BY p.name;
SELECT p.name FROM products p WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM stock GROUP BY product_id HAVING SUM(qty) > 0);
SELECT warehouse, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM stock GROUP BY warehouse ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT dest, SUM(price * seats) AS revenue FROM flights JOIN bookings ON flights.id = bookings.flight_id GROUP BY dest;
SELECT dest FROM flights WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT flight_id FROM bookings);
SELECT origin, SUM(seats) AS seats FROM flights JOIN bookings ON flights.id = bookings.flight_id GROUP BY origin;
SELECT artists.name, SUM(tracks.seconds) AS total_seconds FROM artists JOIN tracks ON artists.id = tracks.artist_id GROUP BY artists.name;
SELECT tracks.title, tracks.plays_count AS play_count FROM tracks ORDER BY plays_count DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT plays.played_at AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM plays GROUP BY plays.played_at;
SELECT orders.id, SUM(dishes.price * items.qty) AS total FROM items JOIN dishes ON items.dish_id = dishes.id JOIN orders ON items.order_id = orders.id GROUP BY orders.id;
SELECT dishes.name, SUM(items.qty) AS total_qty FROM items JOIN dishes ON items.dish_id = dishes.id GROUP BY dishes.name ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT orders.id FROM orders WHERE total > 1000;
SELECT members.name, SUM(workouts.calories) AS total_calories FROM members LEFT JOIN workouts ON members.id = workouts.member_id GROUP BY members.name;
SELECT members.name, SUM(workouts.minutes) AS total_minutes FROM members JOIN workouts ON members.id = workouts.member_id GROUP BY members.name ORDER BY total_minutes DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT workouts.on_date, ROUND(AVG(workouts.minutes), 2) AS average_minutes FROM workouts GROUP BY workouts.on_date;
SELECT title FROM pages WHERE rev_count = 0;
SELECT author, COUNT(*) AS revision_count FROM revisions GROUP BY author;
SELECT p.title, r.revision_count FROM pages p JOIN (SELECT page_id, COUNT(*) AS revision_count FROM revisions GROUP BY page_id) r ON p.id = r.page_id ORDER BY r.revision_count DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT s.number, SUM(se.fee) AS total_fee FROM spots s JOIN sessions se ON s.id = se.spot_id GROUP BY s.number;
SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE hours > 5;
SELECT s.number, SUM(se.fee) AS total_fee FROM spots s JOIN sessions se ON s.id = se.spot_id GROUP BY s.number ORDER BY total_fee DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT questions.text, ROUND(AVG(answers.score), 2) AS average_score FROM questions JOIN answers ON questions.id = answers.question_id GROUP BY questions.text;
SELECT questions.text FROM questions WHERE questions.id NOT IN (SELECT question_id FROM answers);
SELECT questions.text, COUNT(answers.id) AS count FROM questions JOIN answers ON questions.id = answers.question_id WHERE answers.score >= 4 GROUP BY questions.text;
SELECT d.name, COALESCE(SUM(r.fare), 0) AS total_fare FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN rides r ON d.id = r.driver_id GROUP BY d.name;
SELECT d.name, COUNT(r.id) AS ride_count FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN rides r ON d.id = r.driver_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY ride_count DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.fare / r.distance_km), 2) AS average_fare_per_km FROM rides r;
SELECT name FROM users WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM subscriptions);
SELECT plan, COUNT(*) FROM subscriptions GROUP BY plan;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscriptions WHERE (start_date <= '2026-03-01' AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= '2026-03-01'));
SELECT companies.name, COALESCE(SUM(deals.amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM companies LEFT JOIN deals ON companies.id = deals.company_id GROUP BY companies.name;
SELECT companies.name FROM companies LEFT JOIN deals ON companies.id = deals.company_id WHERE deals.id IS NULL;
SELECT deals.stage, ROUND(AVG(deals.amount), 2) AS average_amount FROM deals GROUP BY deals.stage;
